rc2_recovery_seal.focus: transactional recovery under uncertain physical cleanup

RC2-P1-01_device_loss_left_running.root_cause: device_lost() returned after a failed _strict_dop_abort before applying the logical LOST transition
RC2-P1-01_device_loss_left_running.fix: LOST, mode=lost, token media fencing and exact terminal receipt are applied before cleanup; failed abort retains the exact pending receipt and never emits RELEASED

RC2-P1-02_retry_did_not_reconcile.root_cause: retry_pending_cleanup() cleared only the pending tuple; prepared handle, plan, token, playing/EOS/terminal fences, Truth lifecycle and session state could remain stale
RC2-P1-02_retry_did_not_reconcile.fix: _reconcile_confirmed_dop_cleanup() retires only the exact execution, refuses to touch a newer prepared/plan, clears exact executor receipt/token/fences, preserves LOST while the device is still lost, otherwise converges READY/RUNNING/PAUSED/RECONFIGURING to IDLE

RC2-P1-03_stale_transport_state_reentry.root_cause: A START/PAUSE/RESUME state observation queued before a stop/abort was replayed by the owner queue during convergence; with intent cleared it re-entered transport stop and wedged the supervised host
RC2-P1-03_stale_transport_state_reentry.fix: _commit_dop_state_if_current() fences queued observations by exact execution and command generation; stale PLAYING/PAUSED cannot be published after stop/abort or device loss

RC2-P2-01_abort_after_confirmed_stop.root_cause: abort after a confirmed stop raised an identity error, resembling an unconfirmed physical cleanup
RC2-P2-01_abort_after_confirmed_stop.fix: abort_dop is idempotent when no DoP execution is active and returns already=true with the exact expected execution_id; the session accepts it only with exact identity

invariants: LOST is logical truth independent of teardown success
No RELEASED Signal Truth event without exact confirmed release
A different/newer execution is never retired by an older receipt
Second cleanup uncertainty never overwrites the first receipt
New acquisition and rebind remain blocked while any exact receipt is uncertain
Stale transport state cannot re-enter stop during device-loss convergence

RC3-P1-01_false_idempotent_release.root_cause: abort_dop/stop_dop with no active local execution copied the caller execution_id and returned already=true, so a caller-echoed ID could certify a release the host never proved
RC3-P1-01_false_idempotent_release.fix: child host returns a release receipt built from stored identity only after NULL is confirmed; parent stores it only when exact/current; already path requires a matching retained receipt; invented/stale/foreign IDs return DOP_RELEASE_UNCONFIRMED or identity mismatch

RC3-P1-02_unconfirmed_release_with_host_.root_cause: a failed STOP/ABORT could leave the host owning A while the session lacked an exact pending receipt, allowing B to appear eligible
RC3-P1-02_unconfirmed_release_with_host_.fix: abort_media/release_active retain the exact prepared receipt on failure/unconfirmation; B prepare and rebind are blocked while pending; retry uses supervised abort/stop and reconciles only the proven exact execution

RC3-CI-01_locked_cargo_retrieval.root_cause: GitHub run 40356585314 dop-native-gate-a failed while updating crates.io and downloading slab: HTTP2 framing layer error
RC3-CI-01_locked_cargo_retrieval.fix: Cargo registry/git cache keyed by Cargo.lock+toolchain; bounded cargo fetch --locked retry (3 attempts, 10/20/30s) with CARGO_NET_RETRY=10 and CARGO_HTTP_TIMEOUT=120 before fmt/clippy/test; no unlocked fallback and no gate weakening
